story.title: Chiratae Ventures Commits $10M to Five Indian Deeptech Startups in Single Deployment
story.summary: Chiratae Ventures has committed $10 million across five deeptech startups in India as part of a targeted bet on the country's untapped advanced technology potential. The fund sees deeptech — spanning areas like AI, semiconductors, and frontier science — as an emerging breakout category in India's startup ecosystem. The names of the five startups have not yet been disclosed publicly.
